capabilities: Pull updates from the remote repository
Stage and commit changes with selectable files
Commit and push in one step
Create and switch branches from the status bar
extras: Desktop only; does not run on Obsidian Mobile because it shells out to the local git executable. Installation from source requires Node.js v16+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Git support, so users must leave the vault or use a separate tool to pull, stage, commit, push, and switch branches.
summary: A lightweight desktop Git client for Obsidian that adds status-bar actions for pull, commit, push, and branch creation and switching.
